steps.title: Tank drive
steps.say: Like a tank: the left stick runs the left side, the right stick runs the right side.

steps.title: Open Robot.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Robot` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find teleopPeriodic
steps.say: Find where it goes. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `teleopPeriodic` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: Type it here
steps.say: Write those three lines inside `teleopPeriodic()`, between its braces.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: Drive it
steps.say: **W / S** move the left side, **Arrow Up / Down** the right side. Push one forward and one back to spin in place.

steps.title: Watch the output
steps.say: See what you're sending to the motors. In AdvantageScope, search for `LeftOutput`, then drag **Drive/LeftOutput** onto the **Left Axis**.
